_note: Hand-written context per match, keyed by ESPN event id. The build script never touches this file. 'stakes' is shown on the next-match card.

401929710.stakes: Two legs, one ticket. Win the tie and the USA goes to the Nations League Finals in March and books a place at the 2027 Gold Cup. Lose it, and the road to the Gold Cup runs through the qualifying prelims.

401929766.stakes: The decider. The aggregate winner goes to the Nations League Finals in March and straight into the 2027 Gold Cup. The loser has to qualify through the prelims.

401870040.stakes: Knockout football at the Concacaf W Championship, the tournament that decides the region's places at the 2027 Women's World Cup in Brazil.
